summary: rom1trs describes hiring an artist for a Gucci-style AI ad: paper storyboards, Claude-generated keyframes and character sheets, Arcads MCP animation at 480p/1080p, then manual 4K grade and retime.
question_it_answers: What is a paper-storyboard to Claude-keyframe to Arcads MCP video ad pipeline?

claims.text: Pipeline pairs hand-drawn storyboards with Claude keyframes and Arcads MCP animation before manual 4K finishing.
claims.evidence: a keyframe per drawing + character sheets
claims.subject: ai-video-generation

recipe_steps: Artist draws every shot on paper first.
Claude generates a keyframe per drawing plus character sheets.
Arcads MCP animates at 480p first; keepers rendered at 1080p.
Upscale to 4K and grade/retime by hand.
title: Paper storyboards to Claude keyframes and Arcads MCP for AI Gucci ad
